turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Hello, this is Vikram from Udaan Credit Finance. This call is recorded for quality purposes. Am I speaking with Ms. Anjali Rao?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thank you. For verification, may I have your date of birth please?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Twelfth of December, nineteen ninety two.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thank you. Your personal loan EMI of eleven thousand five hundred rupees is due on the fifth.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Actually I lost my job last month and I really don't know how I will pay this EMI right now.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Ma'am, the EMI has to be paid by the due date. Can you borrow from someone?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: I'm driving right now, can you call me back in the evening? I can't talk properly.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Okay ma'am, but please arrange the money.
